lines.text: Hello from above the clouds! This is Nova, live from a court floating under the stars, with the planet rising behind the rim.
Welcome aboard! Nova on the mic, broadcasting from Orbit, where the stars are the ceiling and gravity is strictly optional.
Mission control, we are live. This is Nova, and this is the Zero-G Classic. Seatbelts off, eyes up!
Stars out, planet up, lights on. Nova here, and you are floating at Orbit, home of the Zero-G Classic!
Observation deck, let me hear you! Louder than a launch!
Upper ring, you are quiet up there. Make some noise for Orbit!
Shout-out to the Comet Kids in row zero, loudest seats in the galaxy!
Big welcome to Professor Pip, front row, telescope and all!
Countdown with me, Orbit! Three, two, one... noise!
Night shift crew by the airlock, stand up! You earned it.
Forecast for tonight: clear skies, light solar wind, and a small chance of meteors near the three-point line.
Somebody's water bottle has been orbiting the scoreboard since spring. We call it a moon now.
The concession pod has freeze-dried nachos tonight. Hold on to the chips, they float.
A fan asked if the planet behind the backboard is real. Very real. It just likes basketball.
Last season a ball left orbit on a bad pass. Mission control still gets a postcard every year.
Quick reminder: the last shuttle home leaves after the final horn. Nobody sleeps on the court. Again.
Mission control says the stars are aligned tonight. Mission control says that every night.
Beautiful night up here. Then again, it is always night up here.
Thrusters warming up! Here we go!
Engines are humming now. Feel that?
Fuel is flowing, Orbit. Something's building.
We are cleared for liftoff! Orbit is up!
Full thrust! The whole deck is standing!
Now you are climbing! Keep that altitude!
Escape velocity! Nothing can pull this one down!
Afterburners! The whole court is floating!
Gravity just gave up! Cannot miss!
Out of the atmosphere! Nobody touch anything!
Engines went quiet. Relight them, you got this.
Running on backup power. Reboot and go again.
Little turbulence, that is all. Stay the course.
Mission accomplished! Touchdown confirmed. Take your victory lap around the moon!
That is a champion of the Zero-G Classic! Write that name across the stars!
Stuck the landing, start to finish. Orbit salutes you. Safe travels home, and come back soon!
The stars came out for you tonight, and you delivered. Nova, signing off happy!
Every great mission has a few scrubbed launches first. Refuel, and come back to Orbit.
The flight ends here, my friend. The launch pad will be waiting when you are ready.
Gravity won this round. Rematch? Orbit says yes. Nova says yes. Get back up here!
Hands together for our cadet, Orbit! Brave flight. The next launch window opens soon.
